sample_unit: physicians (residents and specialists) in pilot testing

links.outcome: Proportion of physicians who received digital technology training in medical education
links.effect: Only 17% of pilot participants (n=203) had received digital technology training during medical education; knowledge of AI in diagnostics was highest among applications at 48%.
links.quote: Pilot testing revealed only 17% of participants had received digital technology training during medical education, while 91% showed clinical agreement with AI-proposed diagnoses.

screen.reason: Empirical survey/validation study developing and administering a tool (I-KAPCAM-AI-Q) to evaluate Italian healthcare providers' AI knowledge, attitudes, readiness, and agreement.
